turns.Question: Find positions in the input Raman map whose signal-to-noise ratio is below 10, and re-measure a spectrum once only at those positions.
turns.Ans:
I cannot find any attached files or measurement results from today to use as the "input Raman map." 

Please **upload the Raman map file** (CSV, Excel, etc.) or let me know the **date/session ID** of the measurements you are referring to. Once I have the data, I will:
1. Analyze the SNR at each position.
2. Identify coordinates where $\text{SNR} < 10$.
3. Move to those specific locations and re-measure the spectra.

result.note: No files have been attached to this chat. Ask the user to attach one, or proceed with instrument measurement instead.
